nodes.name: call_ai_context
nodes.notes: AI Engine V1 cutover: calls the shared /api/ai-context endpoint (context + server-built OpenAI messages, replacing the legacy in-workflow prompt). Credential: 'AI Context Secret' (Header Auth) — the id below is a PLACEHOLDER, not a real n8n-issued id. After import, open this node and re-select the 'AI Context Secret' credential from the dropdown before activating the workflow.

nodes.name: openai_reply
nodes.notes: Uses the 'OpenAI API' credential (Header Auth: Authorization: Bearer <key>) instead of a hardcoded key — the id below is a PLACEHOLDER, not a real n8n-issued id. After import, open this node and re-select the 'OpenAI API' credential from the dropdown before activating the workflow.
